 Abu Dhabi T10 League 2026: Match 14, RDC vs YL Match Prediction – Who will win today’s match between Royal Desert Champions vs Yas Lions?
 Royal Desert Champions will meet Yas Lions in Match 14 of the Abu Dhabi T10 League 2026 on Friday, November 13, at Sheikh Zayed Stadium, Abu Dhabi.
 By CricTracker Staff Published - 12 Nov 2026, 17:42 IST 
 3 Min Read
 Abu Dhabi T10. (Photo Source: Abu Dhabi T10) Royal Desert Champions will meet Yas Lions in Match 14 of the Abu Dhabi T10 League 2026 on Friday, November 13, at Sheikh Zayed Stadium, Abu Dhabi.
 The Desert Champions picked up their first win of the season in their fourth game, against the United Tigers, and will be looking to continue that momentum and get their season back on track.
 The Lions have been one of the dominant outfits in the tournament and are currently going through a three-game winning streak after they lost their opening match.

 Sheikh Zayed Stadium, Abu Dhabi: Pitch Report
 The pitch at the Sheikh Zayed Stadium in Abu Dhabi is set to be a balanced surface, which could slow down in the second innings. Teams batting first have been successful in the tournament, and the template could be set to follow in the upcoming clash.
 RDC vs YL Head-to-Head Record
 This will be the first-ever competitive match between the two sides. Therefore, the head-to-head is 0-0.
 RDC vs YL Predicted Playing XIs
 Royal Desert Champions:

 Yas Lions:
 James Vince, Andries Gous (wk), Dasun Shanaka, Tom Moores, Ansh Tandon, Jason Holder (c), David Willey, Karim Janat, Fazalhaq Farooqi, Akeal Hosein, Khuzaima Tanveer
 RDC vs YL: Probable Best Performer of the Match
 Probable Best Batter: Sherfane Rutherford
 The southpaw scored a blistering 40 off 13 balls in the Champions' previous game, playing a key role in their first victory of the season. He will be looking to continue the same form in this match.
 Probable Best Bowler: Jason Holder
 Lions skipper Jason Holder has been a key performer for his side, having taken five wickets in four matches. He will be looking to continue the same form and lead his team with the ball.
